reviews.text: Great vets very caring and loving to my cats

The entire team is fantastic with my cats from my focus-challenged kitten to my cranky 16 YO old lady. It has been difficult to find a vet my old lady trusts, but I think we finally found out vetinary services home.

Dr. Weldon is extremely knowledgeable about cats and their particular issues.  And this is not as trivial as it might seem (cat people vs. dog people), as cats have very different issues from dogs.  We have spent a good deal of time at other vets, some great some not so much, and the corporatization is making things worse and more expensive.  Dr. Weldon is very reasonable.

Simply cannot say enough about this phenomenal cats-only veterinary clinic. The entire staff is wonderful and kind, creating a relaxing and patient experience for even the most anxious cat (and owner). I'd give way more than five stars if that were an option!
It was great! They took care of my cat for 2 years, and when she passed, skillman wok next door cooked her up for such a cheap price. Chloe was delicious, 9/10 would eat again.
Dr. Weldon is great with cats!

We love Dr Weldon and the people in the office here!! We drive an hour, one way, to take our pets here. They know what they are doing, love doing it, and ALWAYS have the cats beat interest at hand. Thank you all for loving my babies as much as I do! Highly recommend them for the care for both cats and humans!
We have been customers since 90's very knowledgeable
Best cat doctor ever. All of my 4 cats love coming here and the nurses are so friendly and caring.
Fantastic care with my cat. Put me at ease and gave me a plan to start on. 45 min drive but I would do it again.

Dr. Weldon and her team are the most caring. She makes sure to explain your options and offers plenty of support. There is a huge difference between specialized vets for cats like this one and regular vets.
